verdict.rationale: Gazebo documents its own synthetic sensor data generation, optionally with noise, from cameras, lidar, depth, IMU, GPS and more (gazebo-gh-14), plus realistic OGRE v2 rendering (gazebo-gh-13). It also runs headless as a lightweight server for CI environments (gazebo-docs-2, gazebo-docs-30), which supports unattended data generation. Nothing in the pack documents reinforcement learning or running at scale, so only the data-generation half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: any RL integration (gym-style environments, reset/step APIs), parallel or batched simulation at scale, dataset export or ground-truth labeling tooling, and independent corroboration.
